The September OER visibly requires the older named OIM A/B prerequisites; current 2026 Osiris course 172589 explicitly requires BIN117B, BPRA171 and BPRO100A instead. Both require 102 EC. The sustainable-development minor course title is now Economics and Sustainability. Careers require further study as the current page states. findings.claim: Every selected course and downstream decision
findings.sourceFirstCheck: Re-read the enriched contribution and curricular weight for every retained course, challenging the four removed science courses and the retained climate/planetary-boundary/public-governance context. General rhetoric and ethics are complementary; negotiation is not corporate strategy; annual-report accounting does not establish all corporate finance; data/technical syllabi do not guarantee business applications. Product development is only a partial operations correspondence. Qualitative methodology and a market project do not substitute for the separate external thesis. All affected concepts, ownership/stopping, schedules, traceability, distinctness, alignment and explanations were reassessed. Pairwise differences are 10, 6 and 12 courses; three is a maximum.
